title: Cow
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="34" ry="22" fill="#f5f5f5"/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="52" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="62" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="50" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="26" y="74" width="8" height="14" rx="3" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
  <rect x="40" y="76" width="8" height="12" rx="3" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
  <rect x="56" y="76" width="8" height="12" rx="3" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
  <rect x="68" y="74" width="8" height="14" rx="3" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x="25" y="84" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#6b4c3b"/>
  <rect x="39" y="84" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#6b4c3b"/>
  <rect x="55" y="84" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#6b4c3b"/>
  <rect x="67" y="84" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#6b4c3b"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="46" rx="16" ry="14" fill="#f5f5f5"/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx="18" cy="38" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <!-- ear left -->
  <ellipse cx="10" cy="40" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#f0b8c0" transform="rotate(-30 10 40)"/>
  <!-- ear right -->
  <ellipse cx="37" cy="40" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#f0b8c0" transform="rotate(30 37 40)"/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="17" cy="52" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#f0b8c0"/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx="14" cy="52" rx="1.5" ry="2" fill="#c98a96"/>
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="52" rx="1.5" ry="2" fill="#c98a96"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="44" r="2.5" fill="#2a2a4a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="44" r="2.5" fill="#2a2a4a"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="20.8" cy="43.2" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="30.8" cy="43.2" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d="M12 33 Q10 27 14 26" stroke="#e8d8a0" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M32 33 Q34 27 37 28" stroke="#e8d8a0" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- udder -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#f0b8c0"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="80" r="2" fill="#e0909e"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="80" r="2" fill="#e0909e"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M84 58 Q92 60 90 70" stroke="#e8e8e8" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="72" r="3" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
</svg>
